description: This file defines the User controller class for the OpenCart admin panel, handling user management functions such as listing users, creating/editing user details, enabling/disabling users, deleting users, managing authorizations, login sessions, and autocompletion for user search.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Controller class for managing users in the OpenCart admin panel, extending the base Controller class and providing methods for user CRUD operations, status management, authorization, login sessions, and search automation.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the user list page with filters and actions.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the user list view, typically used for AJAX requests.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML view for listing users, including pagination and filtering.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a user, pre-filling fields when editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving new or updated user data, with validation and permission checks.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables selected users by updating their status.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables selected users by updating their status.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected users from the system.

methods.name: authorize
methods.description: Displays authorization details for a specific user.

methods.name: getAuthorize
methods.description: Retrieves and displays a paginated list of authorizations for a user.

methods.name: deleteAuthorize
methods.description: Deletes a specific authorization token for a user.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Provides the login session for a user (e.g., impersonation).

methods.name: getLogin
methods.description: Retrieves and displays a list of login records for a user.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides JSON autocomplete suggestions for user searches based on username, name, or email.
